## Motivation

The target-only speculative sampling kernel uses coins from `[0, 1)` but selected a target CDF bucket with `coin <= cumulative_probability`. At the lower endpoint, that can accept a draft token with zero target probability. Exact interior CDF boundaries are also assigned to the preceding bucket instead of the next positive-mass bucket.

Fixes #35771.

## Modifications

- Use the half-open CDF condition `coin < cumulative_probability`.
- Require positive target probability before either acceptance-threshold path can accept a draft.
- Update the permissive zero-threshold test to preserve acceptance of all positive-mass drafts while rejecting impossible drafts.
- Add native regression coverage for zero-mass drafts, exact CDF boundaries, and valid endpoint coins.

## Accuracy Tests

- Built the modified `speculative_sampling.cu` with CUDA 13.0 for SM103 and ran `python/sglang/kernels/aot/tests/speculative/test_speculative_sampling.py` on B300: `7 passed`.
- `pre-commit run --files python/sglang/kernels/aot/csrc/speculative/speculative_sampling.cuh python/sglang/kernels/aot/tests/speculative/test_speculative_sampling.py`

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not benchmarked. The hot-path change is one positive-mass predicate and a strict comparison; it adds no allocation, synchronization, or data movement.
